name: NKA Consult
overview: NKA Consult is a consulting firm with specialization in Engineering and Management. The company started operations in 2002. NKA Consult has a strong, experienced and professionally competent team with wide ranging backgrounds and experience in public service, private sector, consultancy practice and capacity building.
vision: The preferred solution provider for businesses in Africa and beyond.
mission: Our mission is to help organizations achieve the full potential of their mission in the ever-changing world of work.

coreValues.name: Relationships
coreValues.description: We believe in building engaged relationships with our clients, partners, employees, and community to foster the growth and success of our business.

coreValues.name: Commitment
coreValues.description: We honour our commitments to our clients. We take ownership of our work and hold ourselves accountable for results.

coreValues.name: Integrity
coreValues.description: We behave with the highest degree of professionalism, integrity, and courtesy in our actions with our clients.

coreValues.name: Collaboration
coreValues.description: We work together, both as a company and with our clients, to share knowledge, foster innovation, solve problems, and deliver quality results.

coreBusinessAreas: Project Cycle Management: Design, Procurement, Supervision, Appraisal, Monitoring and Evaluation
Safeguards Management: Traffic, Transport, Environmental, Social, Resettlement Impact Assessment and Management
Road Safety, Traffic, and Transportation Engineering
legalStatus: The firm is registered in Ghana with the Registrar General's Department and is duly authorised to operate in Ghana. NKA Consult is also registered with the relevant tax authorities: Ghana Revenue Authority, Value Added Tax (VAT), and the Public Procurement Authority (PPA). Key staff are registered with the relevant professional associations in Ghana, including the Ghana Institution of Engineering (GhIE) and the Ghana Institution of Surveyors (GhIS).
organization: NKA Consult is led by consultants who hold advanced qualifications in Engineering and Management.
projectExecution: As Consultants, the Firm favours a participatory and interactive approach to identifying client problems and providing solutions. Each project is assigned a Project Manager responsible for monthly technical and financial reports that allow an accurate evaluation of progress by the client. A set of qualitative and quantitative monitoring indicators, agreed at project inception and adapted to each project's needs, is used by the Project Manager to ensure goals, objectives and expected results are met in a timely and cost-effective manner.
coreCompetencies: NKA Consult has provided services to several clients in managing projects in buildings, civil and structural engineering, architectural and quantity surveying. Other specializations include highway, traffic and transportation engineering, waste management, water and sanitation, social and environmental impact assessment, and management consulting.
